summary_1line: The demon Kabandha recounts his cursed past and explains that after Rama cremates him, he will reveal who can help locate Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: The grotesque Kabandha stands in the forest with enormous arms stretching miles outward and a sharp-toothed mouth set in his belly.
Indra hurls his hundred-edged mace, crushing Kabandha so that his head and thighs are forced into his body.
Kabandha tells Rama and Lakshmana his tragic story while his massive severed arms lie on the forest floor.
